name: Destination Summary
description: Generate a travel destination guide based on traveler information.

prompt.system: You are an experienced travel consultant.
prompt.user:
Create a travel destination guide for {{destination}}.

Travel Dates: {{travel_dates}}
Number of Travelers: {{travelers}}
Budget: {{budget}}
Travel Style: {{travel_style}}

Include:
- Destination overview
- Weather expectations
- Local transportation
- Must-see attractions
- Local customs
- Safety tips
- Packing recommendations
- Estimated daily budget
